DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の変更についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa pagbabago ng tatanggap ng transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。取引先から支店名が変わったと連絡が来ました。登録済みの振込先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支店名変更の連絡を受け登録振込先を直したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Sinabi ng ka-negosyo na nagbago ang pangalan ng sangay. Gusto kong ayusin ang rehistradong tatanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing may abiso ng pagbabago ng pangalan ng sangay at gustong ayusin ang rehistradong tatanggap. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座番号や支店番号も変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nagbago rin po ba ang account at branch number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座番号は同じですが、支店番号は変わっています。こちらが先方の案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ口座番号と変更された支店番号を案内で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho ang account number, pero nagbago ang branch number. Ito ang abiso nila.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita sa abiso ang parehong account at binagong branch number. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい番号で検索して、表示される名義を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hanapin sa bagong numero at tiyakin ang pangalang lalabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示された会社名は、案内と同じです。前の登録を使うと困りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検索結果の会社名が案内と一致すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pareho sa abiso ang lumabas na pangalan ng kompanya. Problema kung lumang rehistro ang gamitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing tugma ang pangalan ng kompanya sa resulta at abiso. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い登録を削除し、新しい内容で登録できます。今、振込みもされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring burahin ang luma at irehistro ang bago. Magta-transfer din ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は登録の変更だけにします。請求書の金額がまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額未決定のため振込をせず登録変更のみ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rehistro lang ang babaguhin ko ngayon. Hindi pa napagpasiyahan ang halaga sa invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Dahil hindi tiyak ang halaga, hilinging rehistro lang at walang transfer. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、登録する画面へ進んでください。最後に内容を見直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tumuloy sa registration screen. Mababasa muli ang detalye sa huli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい支店番号と口座番号、会社名を確認しました。この内容を登録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新支店番号口座番号名義を確認して登録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ko ang bagong branch number, account number at kompanya. Irerehistro ko ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang bagong branch number, account at pangalan bago magrehistro. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 登録が済みました。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tapos na ang rehistro. Salamat sa pagkonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り置きの丸いパンを受け取りにいらした方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kukunin po ba ninyo ang bilog na tinapay na itinabi?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、山本です。このパンを半分に切ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取り置きの丸パンを氏名で受け取り半分に切る依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, Yamamoto. Maaari bang hatiin itong tinapay sa dalawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Kunin sa pangalan ang itinabing bilog na tinapay at humiling ng paghati. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: できます。さらに薄く切ることもできますが、半分だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Puwede. Puwede ring mas manipis; kalahati lang ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半分だけでお願いします。片方は今日食べ、片方は家で冷凍します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 半分だけと当日食用冷凍用の使い分けを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kalahati lang. Isa ngayong araw kakainin, isa sa bahay ifi-freeze.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilinging hati lang at ipaliwanag ang kain ngayon at i-freeze. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切りました。二つを同じ袋にお入れしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Nahati na. Isang supot para sa dalawa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別々にしてください。冷凍する方は、袋のまま持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つを別袋で包んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hiwalay po. Gusto kong iuwi sa supot ang ifi-freeze.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging magkahiwalay na supot ang dalawa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つに分けました。焼きたてなので、まだ少し温かいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pinaghiwalay na. Bagong luto kaya medyo mainit pa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら、冷凍する前に家で冷まします。袋の口は開けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 温かさを踏まえ冷ますため袋口を開けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Palalamigin ko muna sa bahay bago i-freeze. Iwang bukas ang supot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Dahil mainit, hilinging bukas ang supot para lumamig. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方の口を軽く開けてあります。持ち運び用の袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bahagyang bukas ang pareho. Kailangan pa ba ng dalahang bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手提げ袋は持っています。二つを倒さず入れて、会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参手提げへ入れ会計を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: May dala ako. Ilalagay ko ang dalawa nang hindi natutumba, at pakisingil na ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ilagay sa sariling bag at humiling ng bayaran. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計はこちらです。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 演奏会の場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Naghahanap po ng puwesto sa konsiyerto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。音が大きい所は苦手なので、舞台から少し離れて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大音量を避け舞台から離れて演奏を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Hindi ako komportable sa malakas na tunog kaya gusto kong makinig nang medyo malayo sa entablado.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong iwasan ang malakas na tunog at makinig malayo sa entablado. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 芝生の後ろにもベンチがあります。そこから舞台が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: May bangko rin sa likod ng damuhan. Kita ang entablado roon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座っても演奏者が見えそうです。予約席ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後方ベンチの予約席かを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mukhang kita ang tumutugtog kahit nakaupo. Reserved seat ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking hindi ba reserved ang likurang bangko. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのベンチは自由に使えます。開始は三時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Malayang gamitin ang bangkong iyon. Alas-tres ang simula.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ十分あるので、先に座ります。休憩中に飲み物を買える所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始まで先に座り休憩中の飲料購入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May sampung minuto pa, uupo muna ako. May mabibilhan ng inumin sa pahinga?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Umupo bago magsimula at itanong ang bilihan ng inumin sa pahinga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 売店はベンチの後ろです。演奏の間には十分の休憩があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Nasa likod ng bangko ang tindahan. May sampung minutong pahinga sa pagitan ng pagtatanghal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩に買いに行きます。途中で席を離れる時、荷物は持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十分の休憩に荷物を持って売店へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bibili ako sa pahinga. Kapag aalis sa puwesto sa gitna, dadalhin ko ang gamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing dadalhin ang gamit sa tindahan sa sampung minutong pahinga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。再開の時は、舞台の司会が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Mag-aabiso ang host sa entablado kapag magpapatuloy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を聞いて戻ります。今日は後ろのベンチで楽しみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 司会の再開案内を聞き後方ベンチで観覧すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Makikinig ako at babalik. Sa likurang bangko ako mag-e-enjoy ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliing pakinggan ang abiso ng host at manood sa likod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ゆっくりお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発券機でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May problema po sa ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。往復を予約したのですが、行きの券しか手元にありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復予約なのに行きの券のみ受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Round trip ang nireserba, pero papunta lang ang tiket sa akin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing round trip ang reserba pero papunta lang ang nakuha. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面には何と出ていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「券をお取りください」と出ています。もう一枚、下の奥にあるようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発券機の表示と取り出し口奥の券を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: “Pakikuha ang inyong mga tiket.” Mukhang may isa pa sa loob sa ibaba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang mensahe at tiket sa loob ng labasan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り出し口を見ますね。帰りの券が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ko ang labasan. Naiwan ang pabalik.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これですね。行きは六月十日、帰りは十二日で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りの券を取り日付を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito, tama? Hunyo diyes papunta at dose pabalik, tama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Kunin ang pabalik at ihambing ang petsa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付は合っています。領収書も一緒に出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tama ang petsa. Lumabas din ang resibo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 領収書も受け取りました。予約の完了メールだけでは乗れないと思って、確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書受取と紙の券を確認しに来た理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nakuha ko ang resibo. Akala ko hindi puwedeng sumakay sa confirmation email lang, kaya nagpunta akong magtiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Kunin ang resibo at sabihin kung bakit tiniyak ang papel na tiket. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これで往復の券がそろいました。取り出し口は空になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kumpleto na ang round trip. Wala na sa labasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を別のポケットへ入れます。帰りの券も忘れずに持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復券を分けて収納し携行を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Magkahiwalay na bulsa ko ilalagay ang dalawa. Hindi ko malilimutang dalhin ang pabalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itabi nang hiwalay ang round-trip tickets at piliing dalhin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、券をお確かめいただきました。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo, natiyak na ang tiket. Magandang paglalakbay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 収集所の案内についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa gabay sa collection point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。移転するという掲示を見ましたが、小さな地図では新しい場所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい移転地図では収集所が分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nakita ko ang paglipat pero hindi ko matukoy ang bago sa maliit na mapa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang hindi matukoy na collection point sa maliit na mapa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この大きい図でご案内します。今の場所は、ここですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ipapaliwanag sa malaking guhit. Dito ang kasalukuyan, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。新しい場所は、川を渡った先でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新収集所が川のどちら側か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo. Nasa kabila ba ng ilog ang bago?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong kung saang panig ng ilog ang bagong lugar. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 川の手前です。この角を曲がった所にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Bago tumawid ng ilog. Nasa pagliko sa kanto na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡らないのですね。いつから使う場所が変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋不要を確認し変更開始日を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pala tatawid ng tulay. Kailan magbabago ang gagamiting lugar?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking walang pagtawid at itanong ang simula ng pagbabago. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内では、来週月曜日の収集からとなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa gabay, mula sa koleksiyon sa susunod na Lunes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日曜の夜に出すときも、新しい場所へ行けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前夜に出す場合の場所と時間を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung maglalabas Linggo ng gabi, sa bago rin ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang lugar at oras kung maglalabas sa gabi bago iyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出せる時間は、こちらの地区の掲示でご確認ください。場所の変更日は月曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan ang abiso ng lugar na ito sa puwedeng oras. Lunes ang pagbabago ng lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間は帰ってから地区の掲示を見ます。新しい場所の角に印を付けた図を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地区掲示で時間を確かめ位置図を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pag-uwi titingnan ko ang oras sa abiso ng lugar. Iuuwi ko ang guhit na may marka sa kanto ng bago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin sa lokal na abiso ang oras at iuwi ang mapa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの図をどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院のお荷物はまとまりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Naimpake na po ang gamit sa pag-discharge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ほぼできましたが、この白いタオルは病院から借りた物だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院荷物に病院タオルが混ざっていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Halos, pero itong puting tuwalya yata ay hiram sa ospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nahalo sa gamit ang tuwalya ng ospital. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端の印を見せてください。これは病棟のタオルです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ipakita ang marka sa gilid. Tuwalya ito ng ward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分のタオルと一緒に袋へ入れてしまいました。まだ少し湿っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の物と一緒に袋へ入れ湿っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nailagay ko sa bag kasama ng sarili. Medyo basa pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nailagay kasama ng sarili at mamasa-masa pa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの回収袋へ入れてください。ご自分の物は何枚ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ilagay sa collection bag. Ilan ang sariling tuwalya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青いタオルが二枚です。一枚は洗面台に置いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の青い二枚のうち一枚の置き場所を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dalawang asul. Baka naiwan ko ang isa sa lababo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar ng isa sa dalawang asul na sarili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 洗面台に青い物がありました。お名前の札が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: May asul sa lababo na may name tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それは私のです。そちらを受け取って、白い物は回収袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名札付きの物を受け取り病院の物を返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Akin iyon. Tatanggapin ko iyon at ilalagay ang puti sa collection bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Kunin ang may pangalan at ibalik ang sa ospital. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これで青いタオルが二枚あります。忘れ物はほかにありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dalawang asul na ngayon. May iba pang naiwan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 引出しと洗面台を見て、そろいました。帰る前に白いタオルを返せてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 引出し洗面台と荷物の確認完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tiningnan ko ang drawer at lababo, kumpleto na. Mabuti naibalik ang puti bago umuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat ang pagtiyak sa drawer, lababo at lahat ng gamit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確かにお返しいただきました。お気をつけてお帰りください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の設備についてのお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa kagamitan ng kalsada?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家の近くの交差点で、鏡が反対を向いてしまっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交差点の鏡が反対向きになったと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Ang salamin sa interseksiyon malapit sa bahay ay nakaharap sa kabaligtaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat na baligtad ang salamin sa interseksiyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の強い風の後です。前は右から来る車が映っていましたが、今は空が映ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 風後に右方車両ではなく空が映ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pagkatapos ng malakas na hangin kahapon. Dati nakikita ang kotse sa kanan, ngayon langit na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na langit sa halip na sasakyan sa kanan ang kita matapos ang hangin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所は、地図のどちらでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この交差点です。細い道から大通りへ出る所の、赤い柱の鏡です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図と赤柱で鏡の位置を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Itong interseksiyon. Salamin sa pulang poste kung saan lumalabas ang makitid na daan sa malaki.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang salamin sa mapa at pulang poste. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 事故や、接触があったのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 事故は見ていません。今朝、車で出る時に右側が見えず、危ないと感じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事故目撃なしと今朝の見通しの悪さを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala akong nakitang aksidente. Kaninang lumabas nang nagmamaneho, hindi makita ang kanan at delikado ang pakiramdam.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang nakitang aksidente at mahina ang tanaw ngayong umaga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設備の管理先を確認して、状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titiyakin ang namamahala at ipaparating ang sitwasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。鏡を動かそうとはしていません。撮った写真で、向きも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分では動かさず写真で向きを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Hindi ko sinubukang galawin ang salamin. Tingnan din ang direksiyon sa larawan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi ginalaw at ipakita ang direksiyon sa larawan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真を拝見しました。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nakita ko ang larawan. Salamat sa pag-uulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの書類をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapadala po ang mga dokumentong ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。署名した契約書の原本です。相手から原本を送るよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名済み契約書原本の郵送を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Orihinal na pinirmahang kontrata. Hiniling ng kausap na ipadala ang orihinal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilinging ipadala ang pinirmahang orihinal na kontrata. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中に、返していただく物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May laman ding ibabalik sa inyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書だけです。そういえば、自分の控えをまだ作っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書のみで未作成の控えに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kontrata lang. Naalala ko, hindi pa ako gumawa ng sarili kong kopya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing kontrata lang at mapansing wala pang kopya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ封は閉じていませんね。コピーを取ってから戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi pa sarado ang sobre. Babalik matapos magpakopya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一度持ち帰ります。原本を送った後では、この署名を見直せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を中断し原本の控え作成を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Babawiin ko muna. Pagkapadala ng orihinal, hindi ko na mababalikan ang pirmang ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itigil muna ang padala at piliing kumopya ng orihinal. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 近くのコピー機の場所をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maituturo ko ang malapit na copier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚ともコピーし、原本だけを封筒へ入れて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コピー場所を聞き二枚複写後に原本のみ戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Kokopyahin ang dalawang papel, at orihinal lang sa sobre bago bumalik.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang copier at sabihing dalawang papel ang kokopyahin at orihinal lang ibabalik. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店の入口にコピー機があります。この窓口は、あと三十分開いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: May copier sa pasukan ng tindahan. Bukas pa ang counter nang tatlumpung minuto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら今行ってきます。コピーを自分のファイルへ入れ、原本の発送を改めてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り受付時間を踏まえコピー保管後に再来する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pupunta ako ngayon. Ilalagay ang kopya sa sariling file at muling ipapadala ang orihinal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayon sa natitirang oras, bumalik matapos itabi ang kopya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒をお返しします。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ibabalik ang sobre. Mag-ingat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家計の相談にお持ちの表ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito ang talahanayan para sa payo sa badyet ng bahay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。毎月の支出は書きましたが、年に一度払う保険料をどこへ入れればいいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年払い保険料を月次家計表へどう入れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Naisulat ang buwanang gastos pero nalilito kung saan ang insurance na taunang binabayaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang taunang insurance sa buwanang badyet. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保険料は、一年でいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkano ang insurance sa isang taon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六万円です。来年の六月に払います。今月の支出へ六万円と書くと、今払ったようになってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 年額六万円と来六月予定及び今月支出と区別したい意図を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Animnapung libong yen. Babayaran sa Hunyo sa susunod na taon. Kung isulat ngayon na gastos, mukhang ngayon binayaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang animnapung libong taun-taon, susunod na Hunyo at paghihiwalay sa gastos ngayon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払予定として六月へ書き、別に月ごとの準備額を考えられます。六月まで十二か月ありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Isulat sa Hunyo bilang planong bayad at hiwalay na pag-iipon bawat buwan. May labindalawang buwan hanggang Hunyo, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。毎月五千円ずつ残せば六万円になります。月の表には準備する分として書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十二か月で月五千円の準備を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Limang libo bawat buwan ay animnapung libo. Sa buwanang talahanayan, gusto kong isulat bilang paghahanda.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magplano ng limang libo kada buwan sa labindalawang buwan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際の支払いと、残しておく分を別の欄にすると分かりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mas malinaw kung hiwalay ang aktuwal na bayad at itinatabing pera.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この右の欄を準備額にします。すでに家にある一万円は、別に予備費として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備額の欄を設け既存一万円を別予備費として残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gagawing paghahanda ang kanan. Ang sampung libo sa bahay ay hiwalay kong reserba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Gumawa ng kolum ng paghahanda at itabi ang dating sampung libo bilang hiwalay na reserba. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、毎月の収入から五千円を残せるか、ほかの支出も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan natin ang ibang gastos kung makakapagtabi ng limang libo mula sa buwanang kita.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見直すと用意できそうです。六月に払った時は支出へ記録し、準備欄を取り崩したことも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 月五千円を確保し六月支払と準備資金取崩しを記録すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Mukhang kaya matapos repasuhin. Sa pagbabayad ng Hunyo itatala ang gastos at pagkuha mula sa paghahanda.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliing magtabi ng limang libo buwan-buwan at itala ang bayad sa Hunyo at paggamit ng pondo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表がまとまりましたね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maayos na ang talahanayan. Salamat sa pagkonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍売場をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷凍うどんを買いたいですが、まだ野菜と米も選ぶ予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍うどん購入と他の買物が残っている事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Bibili ng frozen udon pero pipili pa ng gulay at bigas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing bibili ng frozen udon at may natitira pang pamimili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 冷凍売場は奥です。溶けるのが心配なら、最後にお寄りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nasa loob ang frozen. Kung alalang matunaw, huli na lang pumunta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら先に野菜と米を買物かごへ入れます。保冷バッグは会計まで畳んでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷凍品を最後にし保冷バッグを畳んでおくと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gulay at bigas muna sa basket. Nakatupi muna ang insulated bag hanggang bayaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Piliing huli ang frozen at ituping muna ang insulated bag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。冷凍うどんは五食入りの袋で販売しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Limang serving bawat supot ang udon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五食入りを二袋買います。このバッグなら入りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五食入り二袋の必要量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dalawang supot ng limang serving ang bibilhin. Mukhang kasya sa bag na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang daming dalawang supot ng limang serving. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自宅まで、どのくらいかかりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バスで二十分です。家から保冷剤も入れてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: バス二十分の帰路と持参保冷剤を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawampung minuto sa bus. May dala ring ice packs mula sa bahay sa loob.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dalawampung minutong bus at dalang ice packs. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計後の袋詰め台で、冷凍品をまとめて入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa bagging table matapos magbayad, pagsamahin sa bag ang frozen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。米と野菜を選んでから冷凍売場へ戻り、会計後すぐバッグに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 野菜米の後に冷凍品購入し会計後すぐ保冷収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Pipili muna ng bigas at gulay, babalik sa frozen at agad ilalagay sa bag matapos bayaran.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing bibili ng frozen matapos gulay at bigas at agad ilalagay sa insulated bag pagkabayad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお選びください。ありがとうございました。
